happened: On Feb 20, 2026 HUD published a proposed rule, "Verification of Eligible Status." It would end prorated aid for mixed-status households, bar them from public housing and Section 8, and require all tenants to re-verify their citizenship or immigration status. The comment period closed Apr 21, 2026. I found no final rule.

happened: After a July 2025 executive order on homelessness, HUD changed its Continuum of Care grant rules to move money away from "Housing First" permanent housing toward transitional housing and treatment. Courts blocked the 2025 changes. HUD's June 2026 grant notice kept the same direction, and a Rhode Island federal court ruled against key parts of it in June and August 2026.

key_dates.event: Executive order "Ending Crime and Disorder on America's Streets."
HUD issues, withdraws and reissues its 2025 grant notice.
Judge Mary McElroy (D.R.I.) grants summary judgment against HUD's 2025 changes.
Same court rules HUD's $1.3 billion transitional-housing set-aside for 2026 cannot be implemented.

legal: U.S. District Court for the District of Rhode Island: an earlier preliminary injunction, then summary judgment (June 29, 2026) finding the 2025 changes violated the Administrative Procedure Act. A federal appeals court refused to let the 2025 limits take effect in April 2026. On Aug 7, 2026 the court granted summary judgment in part against the 2026 set-aside. The court did not bar future policy changes.
closeness: The policy direction matches the recommendation closely. The courts' rulings were mostly about how HUD made the changes, not whether it may change policy.
uncertain: Whether HUD appealed the 2026 rulings and how 2026 grants are being awarded. Congress also ordered expiring projects restored in a 2026 spending law. Newest source: August 2026.

happened: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act (P.L. 119-101), signed July 11, 2026, made HUD's Rental Assistance Demonstration permanent and raised its cap from 455,000 to 555,000 public housing units that can convert to Section 8 contracts. It also eased inspection rules for vouchers and allows up to 25 more housing agencies into the flexible Moving to Work program. It does not broadly favor vouchers or free agencies to sell public housing land.

key_dates.event: 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act signed.
